pad_sequence_to_max_length: pad a token sequence array to a specified max length with a fill value
pad_sequence_with_truncation: pad a sequence to max length and truncate tokens that exceed the max length
pad_pytree_of_arrays: pad multiple arrays in a PyTree structure to the same max length at once
create_seq2seq_fields_from_tokens: create Seq2SeqFields with input target and target_mask from prompt and response token arrays
review_seq2seqfields_dataclass: review the Seq2SeqFields dataclass structure containing input target and target_mask fields for next token prediction
